---
description: "Use when writing or reviewing React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS, responsive layout, accessibility, SEO, catalogue, cart, checkout, or admin UI code."
applyTo:
  - "frontend/**/*.ts"
  - "frontend/**/*.tsx"
  - "frontend/**/*.css"
  - "frontend/**/*.scss"
  - "frontend/**/*.html"
---
# Frontend Guidelines

- Keep pages, reusable components, API clients, state, and styles separate.
- Use typed API models and handle loading, empty, error, and unauthorized states.
- Do not treat frontend checks as authorization; the backend remains authoritative.
- Use semantic HTML, keyboard-accessible controls, visible focus states, labels,
  and meaningful image alt text.
- Verify desktop, tablet, and mobile behavior for user-facing changes.
- Keep animations purposeful and respect reduced-motion preferences.
- Keep product and checkout content truthful to the educational test environment.
- Add component or interaction tests for behavior changes.
- Preserve SEO metadata, headings, canonical URLs, sitemap, and robots behavior.
